capabilities: Ask questions about the current note or editor selection in a sidebar chat
Rewrite selected passages or files and review per-turn changes with undo
Attach vault files, folders, web pages and images as context with @ references
Switch between local CLI agents (Codex, Claude Code) and model API providers
Extend agents with skills, MCP tools, and configurable search providers
extras: Documentation is primarily in Chinese with an English section; mobile API chat is unverified on real devices and local CLI/MCP connections are desktop-only; settings page loads images from the author's server; no free model quota is included.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to converse with an AI about your notes or let an agent edit files with per-turn diffs and undo.
